research_mode: official Home Office accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Officers with under one year service
verified_claims: There were 8,454 officers with less than one year of service, equal to 5.7% of officers.
limitations: The national headcount share cannot identify experience in a parcel's local team.

sources.name: Officers with one to two years service
verified_claims: There were 6,561 officers with at least one but less than two years of service, equal to 4.4% of officers.
limitations: The figure is not mapped to local assignments or properties.

sources.name: Police officer joiners
verified_claims: Excluding transfers, 8,872 FTE police officers joined the 43 territorial forces in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: Joiner totals do not show where recruits were deployed or local service effects.

sources.name: Joiner annual change
verified_claims: Officer joiners increased by 1,017 FTE, or 12.9%, compared with the previous year.
limitations: National recruitment growth cannot be attributed to an individual parcel.

sources.name: Officer joiner rate
verified_claims: The officer joiner rate was 6.1%, compared with 5.4% in the previous year.
limitations: The rate uses a workforce denominator and is not a local public-safety rate.

sources.name: Standard direct-recruit share
verified_claims: Standard direct recruits accounted for 84% of all police officer joiners including transfers.
limitations: Entry-route composition does not indicate local deployment or performance.

sources.name: PCSO joiner change
verified_claims: PCSO joiners excluding transfers increased by 80 FTE, or 8.7%, in the latest year.
limitations: A national recruitment change does not establish parcel-level service availability.

sources.name: Police staff joiner change
verified_claims: Police staff and designated officer joiners excluding transfers decreased by 1,938 FTE, or 21.1%.
limitations: The change is an organisational workforce statistic and not local risk evidence.

sources.name: Special constable joiner change
verified_claims: Special constable joiners increased by 92 headcount, or 9.4%, in the latest year.
limitations: Headcount change does not measure hours worked or parcel-level coverage.

sources.name: Police officer leavers
verified_claims: Excluding transfers, 9,240 FTE police officers left the 43 territorial forces in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: Leaver totals are national turnover data and cannot identify local service effects.

sources.name: Leaver annual change
verified_claims: Officer leavers increased by 445 FTE, or 5.1%, compared with the previous year.
limitations: National turnover change is not a parcel-level public-safety measure.

sources.name: Officer leaver rate
verified_claims: The officer leaver rate was 6.3%, compared with 6.0% in the previous year.
limitations: The rate is an approximate turnover indicator and does not track individual local teams.

sources.name: Voluntary resignation share
verified_claims: Voluntary resignation was the most common exit reason, accounting for 51.4% of police officer leavers.
limitations: Exit-reason composition cannot be used to infer local police availability at an address.

sources.name: Voluntary resignation rate
verified_claims: The voluntary-resignation leaver rate was 3.2%, unchanged from the previous year.
limitations: The workforce rate is not a local incident or response metric.

sources.name: Police officer leaver headcount
verified_claims: There were 9,426 police officer leavers excluding transfers on a headcount basis.
limitations: Headcount and FTE are different conventions and neither provides parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: Leavers with under one year service
verified_claims: Of headcount leavers, 846, or 9.0%, had less than one year of service.
limitations: The service band is not mapped to local deployment and cannot score a parcel.

sources.name: Leavers with one to five years service
verified_claims: Of headcount leavers, 2,357, or 25.0%, had one to less than five years of service.
limitations: The national distribution does not show impacts on any specific neighbourhood.

sources.name: Resignations with under five years service
verified_claims: Among voluntary resignations, 60.6% had less than five years of service.
limitations: A national resignation profile is not exact-address public-safety evidence.

sources.name: Resignations with five to ten years service
verified_claims: Among voluntary resignations, 17.2% had five to less than ten years of service.
limitations: The aggregate share cannot identify local staffing continuity.

sources.name: Resignations with ten-plus years service
verified_claims: Among voluntary resignations, 22.1% had ten years of service or more.
limitations: The figure cannot be spatially attributed to a parcel or local team.

sources.name: Police officer promotions
verified_claims: There were 2,837 police officer promotions on a headcount basis in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: Promotion counts describe workforce structure and not local incident risk.

sources.name: Promotion annual change
verified_claims: Police officer promotions decreased by 23.8% from 3,725 in the previous year.
limitations: The national change cannot be interpreted as a parcel-level service outcome.

sources.name: Promotion rate
verified_claims: The promotion rate was 1.9% of officers in post at the start of the year, compared with 2.5% previously.
limitations: The rate is based on workforce counts and not geographic service quality.

sources.name: Constable-to-sergeant promotions
verified_claims: Promotions from constable to sergeant accounted for 60.4% of all promotions.
limitations: Promotion mix cannot establish supervisory coverage at a particular address.

sources.name: Chief-officer promotion share
verified_claims: Promotions to chief officer accounted for 1.6% of all promotions.
limitations: A national hierarchical share is not parcel-level evidence.

sources.name: Minority ethnic officers
verified_claims: There were 12,301 FTE officers from minority ethnic groups excluding White minorities, representing 8.7% of officers who stated ethnicity.
limitations: Demographic data must not be used to profile individuals, groups or parcels.

sources.name: Minority ethnic representation trend
verified_claims: The proportion of officers from minority ethnic groups excluding White minorities increased from 3.9% in March 2007 to 8.7% in March 2026.
limitations: A national representation trend is not a local public-safety indicator.

sources.name: Officer ethnic-group shares
verified_claims: Among officers who stated ethnicity, Black officers represented 1.3%, Asian officers 3.9%, mixed officers 2.7%, and other ethnic groups 0.8%.
limitations: Demographic proportions must not be used for risk inference about people or locations.

sources.name: PCSO and special-constable diversity
verified_claims: PCSOs had the highest minority ethnic representation at 14.3%, followed by special constables at 13.1%.
limitations: Workforce diversity statistics are not parcel-level public-safety evidence.

sources.name: Female police officers
verified_claims: There were 53,712 FTE female police officers, representing 36.8% of officers where sex was known.
limitations: Sex-disaggregated workforce data must not be used to profile people or infer parcel risk.
